description: Fences the explainer pipeline agents: the readers and scorer see only the review packet; the authors never see the packet, canaries or benchmark. Does nothing for any other agent or session.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); case "$in" in *explainer:novice-reader*|*explainer:expert-reader*|*explainer:scorer*|*explainer:teacher*|*explainer:curriculum-designer*) printf '%s' "$in" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/reader-fence.mjs" ;; esac
